page.overview:
What is Scarlet-Purple Kingdom?

The Scarlet-Purple Kingdom is a moated city surrounded by towered gates and orderly parapets, fronted by tall mountains to the north and south. The kingdom has an incredibly large market and considerable sea trade, with large ships importing precious gems from other nations.
